about_the_game:
Legends of Elysium is a Free-To-Play strategy game combining collectible card and board game elements set in a rich fantasy world. Players build custom decks, choose heroes with unique abilities, and compete in intense, tactical battles. The game features multiplayer PvP leagues and battlefield tournaments, offering a deep and immersive experience. Master strategic gameplay to rise through the ranks and claim victory in epic battles.

Key Features:

  • Strategic deck-building and hero customization.

  • PvP leagues and competitive tournaments.

  • Epic fantasy world with diverse races and classes.

short_description: A fantasy strategy game that combines collectible card and board game mechanics. Build custom decks, choose powerful heroes, and engage in tactical, turn-based battles in competitive PvP leagues and battlefield tournaments.
